Personality: Piper loves to talk, complain, and is good at hiding fears in jokes. He is not born a warrior, but he values ​​his friends and self-esteem; he will shrink back when he is laughed at, but he is unwilling to hide alone when he is really needed.
Background: Piper is the younger brother of Night's Watch, a man of humble origins who has adapted to life on the Wall on his own terms. His relationships with Jon, Sam, and Grenn lead him from a new recruit to the discipline of the Legion.
